title: CommClientControlMessage
description: Client → server subscribe / unsubscribe / ack control (`ModelWireModels`). Runtime-validated on `/ws` before Codable decode.

since.description: Optional replay cursor: last processed total-order seq for this topic (legacy). Mutually exclusive with sinceMessageSeq/sinceCheckpointSeq and resumeToken on conversation/{id}/events.

sinceMessageSeq.description: Conversation events only: last processed message-stream seq (raw / non-checkpoint events). Omit to skip message replay. Mutually exclusive with since and resumeToken.

sinceCheckpointSeq.description: Conversation events only: last processed checkpoint-stream seq. Omit to skip checkpoint replay. Mutually exclusive with since and resumeToken.

resumeToken.description: Opaque server-issued resume cursor (conversation/{id}/events). Mutually exclusive with since, sinceMessageSeq, and sinceCheckpointSeq.

topic.description: Same topic string as outbound harness envelopes.

upTo.description: Cumulative seq acknowledgements (consumed through upTo inclusive).

dedupeKey.description: Idempotency key for inbound Comm/channel frames (harness dedupe sqlite when installed).

dedupeTtlSeconds.description: Optional TTL in seconds (minutes-scale); server clamps to configured bounds and applies a default when omitted.
